coordinates.root: Identity export root at swimming body center; no baked stand

concept.reason: Inspected named fossil imagery and museum context suffice for this bounded silhouette brief; no extra generated concept is needed. Hidden depth and soft tissues remain explicitly inferred.

scope: Genus-level original low-poly living reconstruction; Cladoselache fyleri AMNH FF 7333 anchors head and pectoral anatomy. Not a measured specimen replica.

scientific_limits.en: Color, body thickness, pose and unpreserved soft tissues are artistic estimates. Selected references support the stated diagnostic silhouette, not every reconstructed detail or exact dimensions. No place-specific coexistence claim.
scientific_limits.zh: 配色、体厚、姿态和未保存软组织为美术估值；资料支持所列鉴别轮廓，不证明所有复原细节或精确尺寸，不作特定地点共存声称。

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: wide mouth, short blunt head and broad-based paired fins. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：宽口、短钝头与宽基成对鳍。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

required_features: Broad transverse mouth near anterior end; short blunt head, not a pointed modern-shark snout.
Broad-based paired pectoral fins; smaller paired pelvic fins distinctly separated from the tail.
Torpedo trunk, two dorsal fins, forked tall caudal fin; no Stethacanthus anvil or unrelated fantasy spikes.

scale.basis: Artistic representative size estimate, not measured from the illustrated specimen; do not claim a taxon maximum.

style.direction: Refined low-poly with deliberate loft/profile topology and restrained neutral palette; avoid untreated primitive assembly.

required_checks: Two isolated deterministic rebuilds and semantic digest comparison
Exact GLB clean-import front, side, top and perspective image inspection
Fresh independent visual, factual and specification review; retain real PENDING until reviewed
reference_obligations: Keep original inventory shape gate; do not replace it with a name/scale/pose variation.
No requirement for one complete fossil; combine complementary evidence and label inference.
No additional default turntable, detail image, scientific or platform gate.
